labels.exposure: Darken or brighten the overall picture
labels.contrast: The difference in brightness between the light and dark areas of an image
labels.highlights: Increase or decrease the bright sides of the picture
labels.shadows: Controls the brightness of the darkest areas of your photo
labels.whites: Change the overall brightness of an image along with the white point
labels.blacks: Controls the overall darkest pixels in your image along with the black point
labels.temperature: Shift colors between warm (yellow) and cool (blue) tones
labels.tint: Shift colors between green and magenta tones
labels.vibrance: Boost the intensity of muted colors while protecting already saturated ones
labels.saturation: Increase or decrease the intensity of all colors equally
labels.clarity: Add or remove mid-tone contrast for a punchier or softer look
labels.dehaze: Remove or add atmospheric haze from the image
labels.texture: Enhance or soften fine details and surface patterns
